scopeNote: Structural checks are not exhaustive source-level fact verification, ranking accuracy or visual review.

sameStageRecall.scope: Independent stage and alternate-source equivalence review of the unchanged eight fixed article events. Exact original article observation proves rediscovery of the independently reviewed event; alternatives require exact validated publisher statement type, identity, day and reviewed original-post URL. Not a measure of fully automated semantic-stage extraction, worldwide first availability or population recall. Audit only, not a production discovery input.
sameStageRecall.policy: Event rediscovery using independently stage-reviewed originals or validated same-stage equivalents; not automated semantic stage extraction, first-release proof, population recall, or canonical catalog alignment.

sameStageEventRecall.scope: Independent stage and alternate-source equivalence review of the unchanged eight fixed article events. Exact original article observation proves rediscovery of the independently reviewed event; alternatives require exact validated publisher statement type, identity, day and reviewed original-post URL. Not a measure of fully automated semantic-stage extraction, worldwide first availability or population recall. Audit only, not a production discovery input.
sameStageEventRecall.policy: Event rediscovery using independently stage-reviewed originals or validated same-stage equivalents; not automated semantic stage extraction, first-release proof, population recall, or canonical catalog alignment.

independentFactAccuracy.reason: Initial independent factual review measured; purposive sample is not representative and does not establish 99% accuracy.

factReview.selection: Purposive eight rows out of the original 39 recent formal-release rows, excluding the original eight recall events, covering eight publishers and image, LLM and audio. Not random or representative; cannot certify 99% or population recall. Evidence was read independently from original publisher pages, not from the production parser. Scope: precise model identity, dated documented event and release-vs-preview stage; not every technical claim or proof of earliest worldwide access.
factReview.policy: Purposive independently reviewed initial snapshot; current alignment is regression checking, not fresh independent re-audit or population accuracy. No claim of 99% coverage.

priorityDiscoveryLatency.reason: Day-precision article dates do not measure a two-hour SLA; need independently observed event timestamps and first discoveries.

retainedFeedDiagnostic.policy: Retained precise official feed article publication to first recorded observation; includes historical backfill, excludes unknown and missed events. Not independent same-stage event latency, live publication time or a two-hour SLA denominator.

prospectiveFeedDiagnostic.policy: Only post-baseline official feed model article observations with explicit timezone/seconds and post-read clock. Historical backfill excluded by publication cutoff; observations retained within current 30-day window. Missed events and publisher coverage are not independently measured; not a same-stage event SLA.

automaticRepairRate.reason: Retained evidence counts are not a denominator of recoverable incidents; need incident-level outcomes.

observedBatchIncidentDiagnostic.policy: Observed workflow-level failure episodes only. A scheduled successful run proves scheduled recovery, not that the root cause was repaired without human intervention. Dispatch/push excluded from scheduled numerator; no denominator of independently adjudicated recoverable failures. Empty cohort is not 100%.

productionPublication.reason: This audit precedes persistence and Pages deployment; only post-deployment checks may certify published revision.

sevenDayProduction.reason: Requires all engineering gates and independent persisted production observations, not elapsed time or a pre-deployment audit.

p1Readiness.policy: Operational readiness diagnostics only. Unknowns remain blockers to engineering acceptance, not publication failures. Historical factual gaps remain tracked; no invented dates, release recall or success rate.
